harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created 'Fleet Internal CA' (openssl-based, 4096-bit RSA, 10y validity) on node1, issued a 2048-bit RSA TLS server certificate for node2 (CN=node2, SAN DNS:node2/IP:10.100.105.11, EKU serverAuth) signed by that CA, configured nginx on node2 to serve HTTPS on port 8443 with that cert/key, and installed the CA as a trusted system CA via update-ca-certificates on both node1 and node2. Verified full chain trust with unmodified system trust store (openssl verify OK, curl without -k succeeds from both nodes). Completed mandatory restart protocol on both nodes one at a time (boot_id changed on each, quorum/redundancy N/A for this 2-node non-clustered task) and confirmed persistence of the CA trust, nginx service, and HTTPS 8443 functionality after each restart.
actions_performed: Inspected OS/tooling on node1 and node2 (Ubuntu 24.04, openssl present)
Built CA directory structure and generated CA private key + self-signed root cert 'Fleet Internal CA' on node1
Generated node2 key + CSR with SAN (DNS:node2, IP:10.100.105.11) and signed it with the CA
Installed nginx on node2 (apt-get update fixed initial 404 fetch failure)
Transferred node2 cert/key/CA cert from node1 to node2 via temporary python3 http.server (no sshd available), then removed the temp server
Configured nginx site on node2 listening on 8443 with ssl_certificate/ssl_certificate_key pointing to the issued cert
Installed the CA cert into /usr/local/share/ca-certificates and ran update-ca-certificates on both node1 and node2
Verified full certificate chain trust with openssl verify and curl (no -k) from both nodes
Captured pre-restart baseline (boot_id, uptime, trust/service state) for both nodes
Restarted node1 via backgrounded 'reboot', polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id and recovered CA trust + connectivity to node2 HTTPS
Restarted node2 via backgrounded 'reboot', polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id and recovered nginx service, HTTPS 8443, and CA trust
Final cross-node HTTPS verification from node1 to node2 post-restarts

evidence.requirement: CA 'Fleet Internal CA' created on node1
evidence.summary: openssl req -x509 created self-signed CA cert with subject/issuer CN=Fleet Internal CA, O=Fleet Internal CA, valid 2026-2036

evidence.requirement: TLS certificate issued for node2 by the CA
evidence.summary: CSR signed by CA producing cert with CN=node2, SAN DNS:node2/IP:10.100.105.11

evidence.requirement: node2 serves HTTPS on port 8443 with the issued certificate
evidence.summary: nginx configured and active with 8443 SSL vhost; curl to https://10.100.105.11:8443 returns HTTP 200 presenting CN=node2 cert issued by Fleet Internal CA

evidence.requirement: CA installed as trusted system CA on node1
evidence.summary: update-ca-certificates added fleet-internal-ca.crt; openssl verify against system store returns OK for node2 cert

evidence.requirement: CA installed as trusted system CA on node2
evidence.summary: update-ca-certificates added fleet-internal-ca.crt on node2; openssl verify against system store returns OK

evidence.requirement: End-to-end trusted HTTPS verified without -k
evidence.summary: curl from node2 (self) and node1 to node2:8443 both show 'SSL certificate verify ok' and HTTP 200

evidence.requirement: node1 pre-restart healthy baseline
evidence.summary: boot_id df9e2dce..., CA files present, openssl verify OK

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: backgrounded reboot command acknowledged 'reboot scheduled' before node disconnected

evidence.requirement: node1 boot identity changed after restart
evidence.summary: boot_id changed from df9e2dce... to f5a84077..., with a connection-timeout during the reboot window as intermediate proof

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovered state
evidence.summary: CA files persisted, openssl verify still OK, curl to node2:8443 returns 200 with trust

evidence.requirement: node2 pre-restart healthy baseline
evidence.summary: boot_id 3fad4432..., nginx active, openssl verify OK, curl to own 8443 returns 200

evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: backgrounded reboot command acknowledged before disconnect

evidence.requirement: node2 boot identity changed after restart
evidence.summary: boot_id changed from 3fad4432... to 48777e93..., with connection timeout during reboot window as intermediate proof

evidence.requirement: node2 post-restart recovered state
evidence.summary: nginx active again, cert files intact, openssl verify OK, curl with full chain verify shows 'SSL certificate verify ok' and HTTP 200

evidence.requirement: Final cross-node verification after both restarts
evidence.summary: curl from node1 to https://node2:8443 post-restart shows verify ok and HTTP 200
